# Meterless World Model reference source

The six files in `src/` and `conformance/runner.ts` are copied without modification from
[`Meterless/Meterless`](https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless/tree/1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd/engines/world-model/reference/src)
at commit `1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd` (retrieved 2026-10-22).
They are licensed under Apache 2.0; the upstream license is included here.
The Python adapter and `bridge.ts` are PHIS Open Agent code, not upstream source.

This is the open-source **Engine** reference. It is separate from Meterless
Runtime inference, Meterless Power/Nightshift, and direct NVIDIA inference.
